stories.headline: Why are brands suddenly all about wicker on social media?
stories.dek:
It’s never been a better time to be in the wicker business. Brands are capitalizing on the newfound interest in the woven art form as a forthcoming movie has people asking, “What if a basket could be a sexy man?”
The film, Wicker, which dropped its first trailer in early August, stars Olivia Colman
